hints.title: Penalty Decomposition
hints.text: At closing hour j, the penalty is the number of 'N' before hour j plus the number of 'Y' at or after hour j.

hints.title: Initial Baseline at Hour 0
hints.text: Closing at hour 0 incurs a penalty equal to the total count of 'Y' in customers.

hints.title: Online Penalty Differential
hints.text: Moving the closing hour from j to j + 1: if customers[j] is 'Y', penalty decreases by 1; if customers[j] is 'N', penalty increases by 1.

hints.title: Running Penalty Minimization Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass after initial character count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Calculating penalty from scratch at every closing hour requires O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space without storing prefix arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses a running differential update to track optimal closing hour in linear time.
